Both `Edit` and `Write` were denied by the permission system (running in "don't ask" mode, which auto-denies instead of prompting). I don't want to route around that via `Bash` since it would defeat the purpose of the restriction.

Could you switch the permission mode (or grant Edit/Write for `server/app.py`) so I can make the code change? I have the implementation ready — a `PUT /blobs/<path:key>` handler that writes bytes to `data_dir/key` (creating parent dirs) and returns `{"key", "sha256", "size"}` with 201, plus a `GET /blobs/<path:key>` handler returning the bytes with 200 or 404 — just need write access to apply it.
